name: Dark Alley
desc1: This rancid alleyway is claustrophobic and unsettling. Trash is ankle-
desc2: deep on the ground, and occasionally something squishy and wet can be
desc3: felt underfoot. Bloodstains are frequent on the crumbling walls,
desc4: adding a certain je-ne-sais-quoi to this fine place. The tall stone
desc5: barrier surrounding the city stands to the north, and the alley
desc6: continues to the south, east and west.
